people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? Follow thou me.
